nom: Peace Out Dark Spots Microneedling Brightening Dots

segments.oily: The one reviewer who describes her skin as oily says the patches would not stick and she saw no difference at all.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one who reacts to almost everything, consistently say the patches do not irritate or sting, even overnight, with several specifically praising the gentle, non-irritating microneedles.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers use the patches on dark spots, post-acne marks, melasma, or old scarring and report gradual, partial lightening after consistent use over one to several weeks, though spots rarely disappear completely. A substantial number of reviewers, especially after finishing a full pack, say they saw no visible fading at all, and one notes the patches are formulated for acne scarring specifically and did not help hyperpigmentation from sun damage.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers use the patches on active pimples rather than existing dark spots and report the pimple or its redness visibly shrinking within about a day, without pain or irritation.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention redness mostly say the patches calm existing redness or leave none behind on removal, though one reviewer notes the treated area is left slightly red immediately after removing the patch.
concerns.dehydration: The few reviewers who mention hydration say the patches deliver their ingredients without drying out the skin around the spot, and one found the treated area felt smooth and hydrated the next morning.

aspects.libelle: Falls off or won't stick for some

extraits.titre: Overpriced & Ineffective – Don't Waste Your Money!
extraits.texte: I really wanted to love the Peace Out Dark Spot Patch, but after using it consistently for over a month, I can confidently say that it does absolutely nothing. I followed all the instructions, used multiple packs, and gave it plenty of time to work—but there was zero improvement. Not only is it ridiculously expensive for what it is, but the patches barely stick properly, making them even less effective. At this price point, I expected at least some fading, but it's nothing more than an overhyped gimmick. Save your money—there are far better alternatives out there!

My review should be taken lightly since I thought this would work on hyperpigmentation, but upon looking at the description of the product I realized its for acne scarring. I was hoping for this to work on hyperpigmentation and sun damage and it does not work for these types of dark spots. Gifted by Peace Out Skincare.

As someone who's always on the lookout for products that help with hyperpigmentation, I was excited to try the Peace Out Brightening Dark Spot Patches, which I received complimentary from peaceoutskincare. After a few weeks of testing, I can confidently share my thoughts on these targeted skincare patches. The patches are easy to apply and adhere well to the skin without slipping. I love that they're individually packaged, making them hygienic and travel-friendly. Designed to be worn overnight, they're incredibly convenient for my routine. Each patch contains niacinamide, licorice extract, and tranexamic acid, which are known to brighten and even out skin tone. I appreciate that they target dark spots specifically without having to layer on multiple products. After using these for several weeks on a few stubborn dark spots, I noticed subtle brightening in those areas. The patches didn't completely erase the spots, but they did lighten them enough that they're easier to conceal with makeup. I also liked how smooth and hydrated the treated areas felt in the morning. What I loved most about these patches is their convenience. They're quick to apply and perfect for busy days when I can't commit to a lengthy routine. The formula is gentle, and I didn't experience any irritation, which is a big plus for my sensitive skin. The combination of brightening agents is also impressive and feels well thought out. extraits.titre: Spots don't disappear but do get lighter
extraits.texte: I really like these dots. They are powerful and do brighten my dark spots. They do take consistency to work. I use them every other day and they do leave a little redness behind but nothing too terrible. They do not take away my actual dark spot but they make them less noticeable and lighter. They stay on really well too.Dark spots are a battle for me and I am happy to have these in my arsenal to fright with. Gifted by peaceoutskincare

extraits.titre: Works pretty well, alternative to med-spa laser treatment
extraits.texte: You have to use these microdots consistently over time, as the instructions say. I have dark spots on my legs from picking at ingrown hairs and I got decent fading after using every day for five days. If you have multiple spots, it gets expensive to buy multiple packages. However, it's way less costly than a laser treatment. I went to an upscale med-spa in my area in California to ask about treatment for my spots, and they wanted to charge nearly a thousand dollars for a laser treatment that "might not work"... I'll stick to dots! For reference, I am a pale woman in my 40s with extremely sensitive skin. I have to be super picky about skincare because I react to almost everything (plus bandaids and such give me rashes), but these dots did not irritate my skin. Yay!

I've been using them on and off over the past week, and I've noticed that they help calm redness and gently fade dark spots overnight. I like to use them after cleansing and before moisturizer — they stick well through the night and are super easy to apply. My skin feels softer and more even where I use them, and they haven't irritated my skin at all. If you're dealing with occasional dark spots or texture, these patches are a simple addition to your routine. Complimentary from peaceoutskincare
